messages:
sara: Heads-up — ratecard convergence rollout. Quick async sync on dependencies: metering adapter, billing mapping, quota enforcement, and contract notifications. Timeline: canary next Tue, GA in ~3 weeks. Need owners and clear milestones. Pinged @mike @ana @kevin @julia.

mike: I can own the billing mapping. I will need example meter events and the list of impacted plan_ids. @ana can you drop a sample event and field spec? cc @julia for contract implications.

ana: (typo — meant ana) ana: Yep, I'll push a PR with sample events and schema by EOD. Current backend emits fields like: resource, unit, quantity, customer_id, plan_id, tags. Example payload: 
```json
{"resource":"token","unit":"token","quantity":27,"customer_id":"acct_123","plan_id":"enterprise_v2","tags":[] }
```
Will include an extra optional field `idempotency_key` for dedupe.

kevin: Platform will update the metering adapter. A few questions: what's the SLA for meter processing (ms)? We also need idempotency guidance and the Kafka topic name. Suggest topic `prod.metric.v2`.

julia: Legal note — if this changes billing semantics for legacy plans we must provide 30 days notice. We need to decide whether this is packaging-only or billing-affecting. If billing-affecting, prepare customer comms and a rollback plan. @sara

sara: This is billing-affecting for a subset of legacy plans — we'll treat it as billing-affecting. Plan: canary to internal / opt-in enterprise customers, then wider GA. I'll draft the customer notice. @mike please surface the impacted plan_ids so legal can triage.

mike: Working on plan list now. Also: quota enforcement — should we pre-check quota at request time or allow post-hoc billing and enforcement? Pre-check preferred from product POV but requires a low-latency quota index from Platform.

ana: ana: Backend can add a pre-check hook. Implementation estimate: ~4 dev-days to add a redis-backed check with 30s TTL. Will include a feature flag so we can flip between pre-check and post-hoc.

kevin: Platform: we can provide a quota service + redis. Need infra capacity request; will open infra ticket and tag eng-infra. Also: recommend SLOs and instrumentation: meters/sec, processing lag, error rate, duplicates.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: ratecard-convergence/canary — start=2026-03-19T09:00Z.

sara: OK milestones to confirm:
- PR with sample events + billing mapping (ana + mike) — by EOD today
- Infra ticket for quota service (kevin) — by EOD tomorrow
- Legal review + draft customer notice (julia) — by Mon
- Can we get a short rollback plan for billing in case GA causes regressions? (mike/kevin)

mike: confirmed. I'll have plan_ids and a rollback sketch by EOD.

ana: confirmed. PR will include event shape + feature-flag toggles.

kevin: noted — will open infra ticket and ping eng-infra.

julia: prioritizing legal review, will follow up with required wording and customer segment list.

sara: thanks all — logging these async notes. I'll post the customer notice draft tonight and follow up with a short playbook for the canary. If anything blocks, drop a quick ping here :thumbsup:
